summary: Capacity-feasible interroute relocate moves one customer between two existing CVRP routes.
description: Input is a feasible set of nondepot routes, indexed demands and capacity. The generator emits each trial and its moved customer. The best-move wrapper also needs the complete distance matrix.

Try all different destination routes and every insertion position within capacity. If the source becomes empty, omit it. The best-move wrapper compares full depot-to-depot distance and returns only a strict improvement. Its metrics helpers retain integer cost precision and use a stable sum for floating-point costs. At most quadratically many placements are visited and each candidate copies the route set.
